title: Scaffolded files point to `amond docs read` pages that never resolve
reason: by design: spec.md maps docs links to amond docs read <page>; track 2 bundles the pages

title: Removing the default registry breaks add/update once blueprints are indexed
reason: by design: spec.md removes Flue's default registry; registry hosting is out of scope and the empty-index guard precedes it

title: Test does not prove the no-network-request requirement
reason: refuted: the positive toContain(NO_BLUEPRINTS_MESSAGE) assertion fails if any fetch precedes the guard

title: Per-package NOTICE names the product 'agent'
reason: style: matches the repo's existing NOTICE convention; no observable defect

title: The new empty-index guard runs before argument validation and the no-arg listing
reason: by design: spec SC-6 and plan T008 require plain amond add/update to exit non-zero with the no-blueprints message

title: Root README still links to the upstream Flue site for the hooks reference
reason: by design: the spec's link rule covers the imported packages only; the sentence labels the link as upstream and temporary

title: Review tool's dismissal ledger is committed in a rename PR
reason: by design: .please/docs/review is the please workspace's git-tracked rejected-findings ledger

title: Scaffolded comments point users at `amond docs read`, which always fails
reason: by design (same defect rejected in iteration 1): spec maps docs links to amond docs read <page>; track 2 bundles the pages

title: Error message tells users to set the internal-only AMOND_REGISTRY_URL
reason: by design (same defect rejected in iteration 1): default registry removed per spec; unreachable behind the empty-index guard

title: hasBlueprints special-cases the empty index and its tests hard-code the empty state
reason: by design: spec SC-6 and plan T008; hasBlueprints follows the generated index and the tests pin the track-1 requirement

title: Attribution asserts Flue's LICENSE names no copyright holder
reason: refuted: vendor/flue at the pinned revision has only the unfilled Apache template LICENSE and no NOTICE file or copyright line

title: Scaffolded comments point to `amond docs read` but no docs are bundled
reason: by design (same defect rejected in iterations 1-2): spec maps docs links to amond docs read <page>; track 2 bundles the pages

title: AMOND_REGISTRY_URL is now mandatory despite being documented internal-only
reason: by design (same defect rejected in iterations 1-2): default registry removed per spec; unreachable behind the empty-index guard

title: Init test does not check the generated amond docs read pointers
reason: not required: SC-7/T009 ask only for no Flue references; the docs pages do not exist yet, so path checks cannot be written

title: Grammar slip: ADR-0004 supersede the ADR-0001 design
reason: refuted: the subject is the compound 'ADR-0003 and ADR-0004' across lines 37-38, so 'supersede' is correct

title: normalizeDocsPath mishandles nested /docs/ URLs and /docs without a trailing slash
reason: by design: the JSDoc documents slicing from the first /docs/ segment; there is no amond docs site, and 'docs' alone is not a page, so an unknown-page error is correct

title: No-content tests fail against the current dist/ and depend on environment state
reason: refuted: the failure came from a dist/ built on the phase 2 branch; after rebuilding phase 1 all 39 CLI tests pass, and bun run test builds first through turbo (TD-002 tracks the dist dependency)

title: Content-guard helpers are exported from a test file and would re-run its suites when imported
reason: refuted: no file imports them; the blueprints guards reuse them inside the same test file

title: No test asserts that package.json files includes docs
reason: refuted: packages/cli/package.json files already lists docs; the pack check is the plan's manual Method, not a required test

title: normalizeDocsPath regresses https://host/cli/docs/ by slicing at the first /docs/ segment
reason: by design: the JSDoc documents slicing from the first /docs/ segment; no amond docs site exists and pages link as /docs/<path>/, so an un-prefixed host is not a realistic input, while GitHub blob URLs now resolve

title: Removing or renaming a slug 404s for already-installed CLIs
reason: by design: plan Non-Goals considered and rejected per-CLI-version registry paths; the 404 tells the user to update amond

title: Default registry points at a site not yet deployed
reason: by design: the first deploy is deferred by a recorded user decision (secrets added before merge)

title: Tests hard-code blueprint counts and reimplement slug derivation
reason: test-design preference: pinned shipped set and independent oracle are intentional

title: Default test run starts a real wrangler dev server
reason: by design: recorded T004 decision; CI provides real Node via mise

title: Include workflow, root package.json and bun.lock in deploy paths
reason: by design: paths list build-output inputs; workflow_dispatch covers tooling and workflow changes

title: Registry app imports the CLI's blueprint-index source through a relative path
reason: out of scope: use-X-instead rewrite of a working implementation

title: Files are written sequentially and frontmatter is parsed twice
reason: out of scope: style/perf nit with no observable effect at this size

title: Pinning wrangler 4.147.0 downgrades the hoisted wrangler and duplicates trees
reason: by design: exact pin follows the two-weeks-old version rule, recorded in tech-stack.md; hoisting path verified

title: Deleting no-content.test.ts leaves the empty-index guard untested
reason: by design: guard protects a broken build whose generated index is empty, unreachable from tests against a built index (T005 Decision Log)

title: Declare eslint in apps/registry devDependencies
reason: out of scope: repo convention of root-hoisted tooling (style)

title: Keep removed or renamed slugs served for already-published CLIs
reason: by design: plan Non-Goals considered and rejected per-CLI-version registry paths

title: Add the workflow file and the toolchain files to the deploy trigger paths
reason: by design: paths list build-output inputs; workflow_dispatch covers tooling and workflow changes

title: The blueprint content test hard-codes a count of 17 files
reason: test-design preference: pinned shipped set is intentional

title: Worker also published on workers.dev without workers_dev: false
reason: refuted: wrangler 4.147 getSubdomainValues defaults workers_dev to routes.length === 0, so a configured route disables workers.dev

title: Fixture registry re-implements frontmatter stripping with its own regex
reason: no observable effect: independent fixture, no blueprint has CR, assertions compare against the same fixture bodies

title: rm(outDir) before writing leaves dist/ empty or partial on a mid-write failure
reason: refuted: scripts/build.ts exits 1 on any error and deploy-registry.yml runs deploy only after a successful build step; emptying outDir first is documented intent

title: Type-only @ai-sdk/provider-utils is an exact-pinned runtime dependency
reason: by-design: tech-stack.md and plan record the exact 5.0.64 pin as a type-only experimental dependency referenced by the emitted .d.mts

title: Comment claims env.run uses a -1 sentinel in sandbox.ts
reason: comment-only inaccuracy with no observable effect; pre-existing in origin/main

title: hasExecStream cannot detect a missing execStream on a Durable Object RPC stub
reason: refuted: @cloudflare/sandbox 0.11.0 getSandbox() proxy defines execStream in enhancedMethods; T010 real-container run confirmed

title: readTextFile null-to-FileNotFoundError mapping copied into five call sites
reason: pure style: one-line null check per call site, no observable defect

title: Sandbox.description is unused and createCwdSandbox concatenates contradicting directories
reason: by-design: description is the AI SDK session field required by FR-8; createCwdSandbox appending the scoped cwd is a recorded plan decision

title: Streaming readFile and writeFile buffer the whole file
reason: by-design: SandboxDriver keeps whole-file primitives (FR-7), so the stream forms must buffer

title: Live Cloudflare spawn kill() never stops the remote command
reason: by-design and documented: sandbox-api.md states no remote kill on cloudflareSandbox execStream; plan records startProcess/killProcess as follow-up

title: Make local spawn kill() settle wait() like other providers
reason: by-design: local() kill is a real process-group kill, so an exit code is the natural outcome; contract only requires wait() to settle

title: run and spawnLive repeat working-directory, env, and timeout composition
reason: pure style: duplication with no observable effect

title: Honor encoding in packaged-skill readTextFile overlay
reason: no reachable trigger: overlay feeds only the model-facing tools, which pass no encoding or signal; model-readable overlay reads are a recorded decision

title: sliceLines drops the trailing newline for a mid-file range
reason: by design: matches AI SDK extractLines; sandbox-streams.test.ts pins mid-file ranges without the final newline

title: Abort right after a normal exit discards the real exit code in spawnLive
reason: provably impossible: exited resolves in the close handler and its continuation runs as a microtask before any abort macrotask; first settlement wins

title: spawnLive duplicates spawnFromRun kill and abort plumbing
reason: pure style: a few lines of shared plumbing, no observable effect

title: writeTextFile rejects non-UTF-8 encodings
reason: by design: documented UTF-8-only write (types.ts, sandbox-api.md); the web platform has no non-UTF-8 TextEncoder

title: readTextFile BOM handling differs between the provider and TextDecoder paths
reason: premise refuted: every UTF-8 label takes the provider readText path; TextDecoder only decodes non-UTF-8 labels

title: Docs comment says exec() works here where the standard tools need run()
reason: by design: mirrors blueprints/sandbox--cloudflare-computer.md:220 verbatim, and the driver does expose exec

title: local() run waits for the shell to close before rejecting on abort
reason: pre-existing: origin/main execShell/exec already settled on close and carried the same doc promise; this diff did not change run's abort path

title: read and edit tools do not pass the tool signal to readTextFile
reason: by design: session.ts wraps every tool in abandonToolOnAbort so turn aborts are prompt; write/edit omit the signal deliberately (agent.ts:206); only the abort message text would differ

title: abortable() is a third copy of the abort-race logic
reason: pure style: the three helpers differ in behavior (listener cleanup, orphan reporting, macrotask grace); no observable effect

title: Redundant throwIfAborted pre-checks and double canonicalEncoding in file methods
reason: pure style: redundant defensive checks, no behavior change

title: Default overflow notice claims 'process killed' though the controller kills nothing
reason: unreachable today: the only capped caller overrides the suffix, and the option doc tells non-killing providers to word their own

title: MAX_BUFFERED_OUTPUT_BYTES duplicates MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
reason: pure style: separately documented constants with different semantics that share a value

title: Kill the local spawn before resolving wait() on unread-output overflow
reason: by design: onOverflow sends SIGTERM synchronously before any awaiter resumes; settling while teardown continues matches the accepted abort design (18e2ba0d) and the local kill() ledger entry

title: Remove the unreachable lifetime-overflow branch from local spawnLive
reason: unreachable defensive branch with no observable effect; OVERFLOW_NOTICE stays in use by run

title: Bound total unread output per live spawn, not each stream separately
reason: by design and documented: maxBufferedBytes is specified per stdout and stderr

title: fail() discards queued unread stdout/stderr chunks
reason: by design: erroring streams discards their queue per ReadableStream semantics; plan records the controller owning stream error and T010 evidence expects both streams errored; the failure reason reaches wait()

title: timeoutMs is rounded up twice
reason: pure style: Math.ceil is idempotent and the driver is never exposed; no observable effect

title: FileNotFoundError exposes the sandbox path in HTTP error responses
reason: by design: toHttpResponse deliberately renders message/meta of every AmondError; the path is caller-supplied or the framework's SKILL.md path; existing errors already expose paths in meta

title: Export the sandbox helper builders for hand-written adapters
reason: API-design suggestion, not a defect: docs direct adapters to sandboxFromDriver and bash(); no behavior is broken

title: Replace readerToBytes with new Response(stream).arrayBuffer()
reason: pure style: the loop is correct and tested, and drainStream needs the reader handle to cancel on abort

title: Guard the grep backend probe against a synchronously throwing run()
reason: contract violation trigger only: Sandbox.run returns Promise; pattern unchanged from origin/main; the following env.run would throw the same way, so no observable difference

title: abortable() reports a completed operation as AbortError when the signal fires in the same tick
reason: by design: mirrors raceExecAbort's documented no-stale-success rule; types.ts says a write rejected on abort may still land

title: readFile and writeFile buffer the whole file instead of streaming
reason: recorded design: file methods are built from whole-file driver primitives (plan, AC-014); origin/main was whole-file too

title: spawn wait() rejects with a wrapped AbortError instead of signal.reason
reason: by design: spec AC-007/FR-5 and sandbox-api.md specify AbortError with the reason as cause; tests assert it

title: assertSandboxShape checks only run, spawn, readTextFile and writeTextFile
reason: heuristic legacy-adapter detector working as designed: legacy adapters lack all four; a partly new adapter violates the typed contract; no realistic trigger

title: Death guard keeps polling after abort while execStream is pending
reason: already bounded: a late execStream is cancelled by if (stopped) stopReading(), the guard settles (cf-spawn.test.ts covers it); a never-settling execStream is bounded by the death detector like every guarded call

title: Bound the SSE parser's partial line and data buffers
reason: unrealistic trigger: frames come from the Cloudflare SDK's per-read events from the user's own container; memory exhaustion needs a hostile endpoint outside the trust boundary

title: overlayPackagedSkills spread drops prototype methods of class-based sandboxes
reason: pre-existing ...env spread from origin/main; all sandboxes are plain objects (class providers are SandboxDrivers wrapped by sandboxFromDriver)

title: sliceLines picks one line separator for a mixed-ending file
reason: by design: exact parity with the AI SDK extractLines, approved by the user

title: resolveSandbox exported only for tests
reason: no observable effect: client.ts is not a package entry and nothing re-exports resolveSandbox

title: Live Cloudflare spawn does not enforce timeoutMs host-side
reason: by design: buffered Cloudflare run also forwards timeout to the provider; docs and spec FR-3/AC-005 require forwarding; exit 124 applies only to adapters that enforce the deadline themselves

title: FileNotFoundError code is dropped by classifyError serialization
reason: consistent design: event serialization projects type/name/message/details/meta for every AmondError; the docstring promises only the instance property; no consumer reads code from events

title: Assignability is checked only against provider-utils 5.0.64, not the harness's nested 5.0.30
reason: @ai-sdk/harness is not a dependency of @amond-ai/agent and the two copies' session types are structurally identical; the plan's STOP condition is not met

title: launchShell settles on 'close' so live spawn wait() waits for a backgrounded grandchild holding the pipes
reason: By design: ShellProcess.exited JSDoc documents settling once the shell exited and both output streams ended; matches origin/main execShell; settling on 'exit' would truncate trailing output because controller.exit closes the streams; AC-012 does not require resolving before pipe EOF
